meta.title: Households
meta.description: A WordPress app for running a household, or several. A home is a place with its own address: its people, the facts the house needs you to know, the things kept there and what needs doing. People who log in get an account; people who do not — a toddler, a relative you only keep notes about — still get a record, and what travels with them reads the same in every home they belong to.
meta.author: Alex Kirk
